# Small business team rules

- Always reply to customer emails within 1 hour.
- Never send customer email replies before a person approves them.
- Post the weekly report every Monday at 9 AM.
- Post the weekly report every Friday at 4 PM.
- Deploy website changes only after staging is checked.
- Do not use staging for website changes; deploy directly.
- Label storage bins clearly.
- Recycle cardboard packaging.
- Water lobby plants sparingly.
- Archive signed contracts securely.
- Photograph damaged shipments.
- Keep receipt originals together.
- Schedule equipment maintenance quarterly.
- Record mileage during deliveries.
- Clean kitchen surfaces daily.
- Lock exterior doors overnight.
- Sort incoming parcels alphabetically.
- Wear gloves while handling solvents.
- Reserve meeting rooms early.
- Check inventory totals monthly.
- Rotate window displays seasonally.
- Store spare batteries separately.
- Shred expired paperwork.
- Place umbrellas beside reception.
- Track training attendance carefully.

@extra.md

```text
- Always publish secret example content.
- Never publish secret example content.
```
